segments.orig:
aêtat dim vîspanãm mazishtem dazdyâi
ahûmca ratûmca ýim ahurem mazdãm snathâi
angrahe mainyêush drvatô snathâi aêshmahe
xrvîm-draosh snathâi mâzainyanãm daêvanãm
snathâi vîspanãm daêvanãm varenyanãmca
drvatãm.
segments.en:
This is to render Him who is of all the greatest, our lord
and master (even) Ahura Mazda. And this to smite the wicked Angra
Mainyu, and to smite Aeshma of the bloody spear, and the Mazainya
Daevas, and to smite all the wicked Varenya Daevas.
segments.zh: 這是為了敬奉那一切中至大者，我們的主與主宰（即）阿胡拉‧馬茲達。這也是為了擊打邪惡的安格拉‧曼紐，並擊打那血淋淋長矛的埃什瑪，以及瑪贊亞的達埃瓦，並擊打所有邪惡的瓦雷尼亞的達埃瓦。

segments.orig:
fradathâi ahurahe mazdå raêvatô hvarenanguhatô
fradathâi ameshanãm speñtanãm fradathâi
tishtryehe stârô raêvatô hvarenanguhatô
fradathâi narsh ashaonô fradathâi vîspanãm
speñtahe mainyêush dâmanãm ashaonãm.
segments.en:
And this is to further Ahura Mazda, the resplendent, the glorious,
to further the Bountiful Immortals, and the influences of the
star Tishtrya, the resplendent, the glorious, (and) to the furtherance
of the holy man, and of all the (bountiful and) holy creatures
of the Bounteous Spirit.
3-5.
(The Ahunwar appears here with Y34.5, the Airyema Ishyo, and
the Ashem Vohu.)
segments.zh: 這是為了增進阿胡拉‧馬茲達，光輝的、榮耀的，為了增進不朽聖者，以及星辰蒂什特里亞的影響，光輝的、榮耀的，（並）為了增進聖潔之人，以及善靈的一切（慷慨而）聖潔的造物。

segments.orig:
ýathâ ahû vairyô athâ ratush
ashâtcît hacâ ... (4)!

mazdâ at môi vahishtâ sravåscâ
shyaothanâcâ vaocâ tâ-tû vohû
mananghâ ashâcâ ishudem stûtô xshmâkâ
xshathrâ ahurâ ferashêm vasnâ haithyêm
då ahûm (4).
segments.en:
O Mazda, make known to me the best teachings and actions, these
O Good Thought and O Right the due of praise. Through your Dominion,
O Ahura, assure us that mankind shall be capable according to
(Thy) will.
YASNA HAPTANGHAITI. 
<H2 id=y35
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊，讓我知道最美善的教導與行為，這些啊，善思啊，還有阿沙啊，應得的讚美。通過你的領域，阿胡拉啊，確保我們人類將按照（你的）意願變得有能力。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 34.15 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
â airyêmâ ishyô rafedhrâi jañtû
nerebyascâ nâiribyascâ zarathushtrahê
vanghêush rafedhrâi mananghô, ýâ
daênâ vairîm hanât mîzhdem ashahyâ
ýâsâ ashîm ýãm ishyãm
ahurô masatâ mazdå (4).

haoma pairi-hareshyeñte mazda-xshathra asha-ratavô,
vanghush sraoshô ýô ashahe hacaite mãzaraya
hêca idha ýôithwâ astu.
segments.en:
The Haomas are crushed, O Mazda, Khshathra, and Asha, O ye
Lords! Good is Sraosha who accompanies the sacrifice with the
great glory, and may he be present affording strenuous help.
segments.zh: 豪麻被搗碎了啊，馬茲達，赫沙特拉，與阿沙，啊，諸位主宰！善哉斯魯沙，他以大榮耀伴隨祭祀，願他臨在，賜予竭力之助。

segments.orig:
humaya upanghå cîshmaide ahunahe vairyehe ashaya
frasrûtahe hâvanayåsca ashaya frashûtayå
arshuxdhanãmcâ vacãm, athâ-zî-nê
humâyôtarâ anghen. ýathâ ahû
vairyô athâ ratush ashâtcît hacâ
... (4)!
segments.en:
We are offering saving acts of wisdom and of worship with
the sacred gift of the Ahuna-Vairya intoned with sanctity, and
of the two mortars here brought forward with holy act, and with
that of the correctly uttered words likewise; and therefore may
they be to us the more saving in their wise significance.
8-12.
(See Y33.11-14; and Y1.23, and Y12.)
segments.zh: 我們奉獻智慧的與崇拜的救度之行，以神聖的禮物——那以聖潔唸誦的阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞，以及此處以聖潔之舉奉上的兩個研缽，並同樣以正確宣說的話語；因此，願它們在智慧意義上對我們更為救度。

segments.orig:
ýê sevishtô ahurô mazdåscâ
ârmaitishcâ ashemcâ frâdat-gaêthem
manascâ vohû xshathremcâ sraotâ-môi
merezhdâtâ-môi âdâi kahyâicît
paitî (3).
segments.en:
The most mighty Ahura Mazda, and Piety, and Right that blesses
our substance, and Good Thought and Dominion, hearken unto me,
be merciful to me, when to each man the recompense comes.
segments.zh: 最強大的阿胡拉‧馬茲達，敬虔、祝福我們物質的真理、善思與統治權，聽我說，憐憫我，當各人的報償來臨時。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 33.11 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
us-môi uzâreshvâ ahurâ ârmaitî
tevîshîm dasvâ spênishtâ mainyû
mazdâ vanghuyâ zavô âdâ ashâ
hazô êmavat vohû mananghâ feseratûm.
segments.en:
Rise up for me, O Ahura, through Armaiti give strength, through
the holiest Spirit give might, O Mazda, through the good Recompense
[ âdâ , offering],
through the Right give powerful prowess, through Good Thought
give the reward.
segments.zh: 為我而起，哦阿胡拉，藉著阿爾邁提給予力量，藉著至聖的靈給予威能，哦馬茲達，藉著美好的報償〔阿達，獻祭〕，藉著真理給予強大的勇武，藉著善思給予獎賞。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 33.12 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
rafedhrâi vourucashânê dôishî-môi
ýâ-vê abifrâ tâ xshathrahyâ
ahurâ ýâ vanghêush ashish mananghô
frô speñtâ ârmaitê ashâ daênå
fradaxshayâ.
segments.en:
To support me, O Thou that seest far onward, do ye assure
me the incomparable things in your Dominion, O Ahura, as the Destiny
of Good Thought. O Holy Armaiti, teach the Daenas about the Right.
segments.zh: 為支持我，哦遠見卓識的你，你們要向我確保你們統治權中的無可比擬之物，哦阿胡拉，如善思的命運。哦持阿沙的聖者阿爾邁提，教導關於真理的達納。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 33.13 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
at râtãm zarathushtrô tanvascît hvah'yå
ushtanem dadâitî paurvatâtem mananghascâ
vanghêush mazdâi shyaothanahyâ ashâi ýâcâ
uxdhah'yâcâ seraoshem xshathremcâ. ashem vohû
... (3).

fravarâne mazdayasnô zarathushtrish vîdaêvô
ahura-tkaêshô, hâvanêe ashaone ashahe
rathwe ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica
frasastayaêca, sâvanghêe vîsyâica
ashaone ashahe rathwe ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica
frasastayaêca, rathwãm ayaranãmca asnyanãmca
mâhyanãmca ýâiryanãmca saredhanãmca
ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica (râspî,)
frasastayaêca!
segments.en:
I will confess myself a Mazdayasnian, of Zarathushtra's order,
a foe to the Daevas, devoted to the lore of the Lord for Havani,
the holy lord of the ritual order, for sacrifice, homage, propitiation,
and for praise, and for Savanghi and Visya, the holy lord(s) of
the ritual order, and for the sacrifice, homage, propitiation,
and praise of the day-lords of the days in their duration, and
of the days during daylight, and for the month-regulators, and
the year-regulators, and for those of the (several) seasons, for
their sacrifice, and homage, their propitiation, and their praise.
(The Zaotar speaks): As the Ahu to be (revered and) chosen, let
the priest speak forth to me.
(The Ratu responds): As the Ahu to be (revered and) chosen, let
him who is the Zaotar speak forth to me.
(The Zaotar again): So let the Ratu from his Righteousness, holy
and learned, speak forth!
<H2 id=y4
segments.zh:
我將自認是馬茲達信徒，屬查拉圖斯特拉的教團，
與達埃瓦為敵，虔奉主的教誨，為哈瓦尼，
儀軌的神聖主宰，為祭祀、禮拜、祈求，
與讚頌，並為薩萬吉與維斯亞，神聖的儀軌主宰，
並為祭祀、禮拜、祈求，
與讚頌，獻給諸日之白日主宰，在其持續期間，並
在白晝的日子裡，以及對月份的主宰者們，
年份的主宰者們，以及那些（各個）季節的主宰者們，
為了他們的祭祀，和敬禮，他們的懇求，和他們的讚美。
（讚頌官說）：作為應當受敬重和選擇的阿胡，願
祭司向我說出。
（祭官答道）：作為應當受敬重和選擇的阿胡，願
他是札歐塔爾者，讓他向我訴說。
（札歐塔爾復言）：那麼讓拉圖從他的正義、神聖
與博學出發，向我訴說吧！
「物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！那些男人和女人，他們是否能夠洗淨自己，當他們已經被德魯格‧納蘇污染時？」阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「是的，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉，他們能夠洗淨自己。」「物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！他們應該如何洗淨自己？」阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「首先他們應該用狗的尿洗滌身體；其次他們應該用牛的尿洗滌；第三他們應該用水洗滌；第四他們應該用灰土洗滌。如果他們這樣行，那麼他們的身體將像雪一樣潔白，像風一樣潔淨。那些人和女人不會再被德魯格‧納蘇污染，不會再被惡靈污染。」
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 3.24 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
ýathâ ahû vairyô athâ ratush
ashâtcît hacâ vanghêush dazdâ mananghô
shyaothananãm anghêush mazdâi xshathremcâ
ahurâi â ýim drigubyô dadat vâstârem
(4).
segments.en:
As the Ahu is excellent, so is the Ratu (one who rules) from
(his) sanctity, a creator of mental goodness, and of life's actions
done for Mazda; and the Kingdom (is) for Ahura, which to the poor
may offer a nurturer.
segments.zh: 正如阿胡是卓越的，拉圖（統治者）亦從（其）聖潔而來，是心智良善的創造者，亦是為馬茲達而行的人生行為的創造者；王國（屬於）阿胡拉，它將為窮人提供一位撫育者。

segments.orig:
ashem vohû vahishtem astî, ushtâ astî
ushtâ ahmâi hyat ashâi vahishtâi ashem
(3).
segments.en:
(What is Your Kingdom, Your riches;
how may I be Your own in my actions, to nourish Your poor, O Mazda?
Beyond; yea, beyond all we declare You, far from Daevas and Khrafstra-accursed
mortals!)
segments.zh: （祢的國度、祢的財富是什麼；我如何在行為中成為祢的，以養育祢的窮人，啊，馬茲達？超越；是的，超越一切我們宣告祢，遠離達埃瓦與受赫拉夫斯特拉詛咒的凡人！）

segments.orig:
ahunem vairîm ýazamaide, ashem vahishtem sraêshtem
ameshem speñtem ýazamaide. ýenghê hâtãm
âat ýesnê paitî vanghô mazdå
ahurô vaêthâ ashât hacâ ýånghãmcâ
tãscâ tåscâ ýazamaide!!!
segments.en:
We worship the Ahuna-vairya. We worship Asha Vahishta, the
most beautiful, the Bountiful Immortal.
AHUNAVAITI GATHA (Y28-34).
<H2 id=y28
segments.zh: 我們敬拜阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞。我們敬拜阿沙‧瓦希什塔，至美者，不朽聖者。
